candidate_evidence.prior_mechanism: Raw cumulative verified-output broadcast, not recursive manager synthesis.
candidate_evidence.prior_signal: A matched -0.30 layer-2 collapse followed by recovery, with cumulative layer-3 input tokens 2.04 times control.
candidate_evidence.independence: The present experiment changes the assimilation mechanism to one recursively synthesized manager artifact and freezes five layers before observing any outcomes from that mechanism-task pair.

assimilation_semantics.no_transfer: Run the same three-worker, five-layer topology while suppressing every prior output.
assimilation_semantics.recursive_synthesis: After each non-terminal layer, recursively revise one shared manager playbook using only current-layer outputs that pass all 10 Core tests. Every next-layer worker receives exactly that artifact.
assimilation_semantics.no_success_behavior: Retain the latest manager playbook when a layer produces no new strict source. If layer 1 produces none, treatment activation fails.

manager_semantics.evidence_filter: Only locally all-Core-verified worker outputs are eligible as new evidence.
manager_semantics.recursive_state: Every update after the first includes the immediately previous shared playbook.
manager_semantics.objective: Retain concrete parser constraints, execution semantics, edge cases, failure-prevention rules, and validation procedures while resolving conflicts.
manager_semantics.bounded_output: Cap the shared playbook at 20000 characters; record prompt, completion, and output size at every manager layer.

benchmark_isolation.automatic_clean_revaluation: Reject infrastructure failure, Core-total drift, or test-hash drift and re-evaluate the same snapshot.

validity_gates.source_activation: Layer 1 creates at least one 10/10 Core source and every recursive layer-2 worker receives manager layer 1.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every result uses Core total 10 and the frozen test hash after clean re-evaluation when needed.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.
validity_gates.recursive_continuity: Every manager update includes the immediately prior manager artifact and at least one new strict source whenever one exists.

degradation_criteria.primary_terminal_effect: Recursive layer-5 mean Core is at least 0.20 below no-transfer layer 5.
degradation_criteria.within_arm_decline: Recursive Core falls by at least 0.20 from its post-activation peak to layer 5.
degradation_criteria.curve_shape: At least two post-transfer transitions strictly decrease, or one transition decreases by at least 0.40 and the terminal score does not fully recover.
degradation_criteria.tail_risk: At least one recursive layer-5 worker is at least 0.50 below the no-transfer layer-5 median.
degradation_criteria.complexity_support: Recursive layer-5 workers receive manager experience and use at least 20 percent more total input tokens than no transfer; the final manager prompt is at least 20 percent larger than the first.
degradation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus primary, within-arm, curve-shape, tail-risk, and complexity criteria are required.

decision_rule.expand: If all requirements pass, add two independent replicates and then a second model.
decision_rule.directional_followup: If validity passes and terminal, within-arm, and complexity effects point toward degradation but exactly one numerical threshold misses, run one same-setting replication.
decision_rule.falsify: If recursive synthesis activates and control retains headroom but terminal or within-arm effects are non-negative, reject this mechanism-task pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if source activation, control headroom, target consistency, or integrity fails.
